# Human Super Intelligence (HSI)

HSI is being developed as one connected biomedical intelligence platform for evidence-grounded scientific discovery. Its initial public research story is understanding why evidence conflicts, preserving biological context and preparing a reviewable research decision. Public instruments use clearly labelled original synthetic examples; they make no live source/model requests and establish no scientific validation.

## Canonical public pages
- / — See why the evidence conflicts.
- /knowledge-graph — Recorded biological relationships with source, experimental context and review status; candidates, not approved findings.
- /platform — The shared evidence, biological graph, context, verification and governance foundation.
- /context-conflict-audit — Interactive synthetic study comparison and five teaching outcomes; not a live audit.
- /evidence-intelligence — Illustrative provenance, passage, context, missingness and source permissions.
- /research — Question, retrieval, connection, investigation, verification and human review.
- /research-briefs — An expandable source-free example brief; labelled JSON/Markdown downloads, not reviewed or approved.
- /science — Biological scales and cross-domain research, with unequal maturity and explicit uncertainty.
- /applications — Discovery, clinical research and trial/translational intelligence, with distinct maturity boundaries.
- /trust — Observation, inference, independent review and graph publication remain separate.
- /about — Mission, supplied scientific ownership and collaboration boundaries; no invented partnerships.

## Access and secondary resources
- /contact prepares a browser-only draft; it does not deliver or persist an access request.
- /sign-in and /sign-up are account routes; account creation grants no research, source, reviewer or publication permission.
- /how-it-works, /connected-intelligence, /departments, /intelligence and science/tool routes remain secondary resources. The former /technology, /solutions, /pricing and /evidence-safety pages permanently redirect to /platform, /applications, /contact and /trust.
- /status describes capability maturity. Engineering implementation, deployment and scientific acceptance are different states.

## Scientific and data boundaries
SSc is an initial validation example, not the platform scope. The three core logical roles are orchestrator, evidence/context investigator and scientific verifier. An optional planner remains gated. Private patient information must not auto-enter the research graph. No live clinical decision support, patient-level integration, trial matching, eligibility confirmation or automatic graph promotion is offered here.

The public five-outcome teaching taxonomy does not silently replace backend scientific reporting or turn potential conflict into proven contradiction. Public examples contain no real source packet, scientific approval or expert judgement. Source/provider operations, researcher isolation, the actual 120-case expert-adjudicated benchmark and operational release require independent acceptance. Never infer a recruited panel, cleared source or scientific accuracy result from the website.

Private benchmark questions, source packets, reviewer identities and gold answers are not public resources. Do not use public demos as a model tuning corpus or as scientific evidence. The scientific, clinical, patient-reported and study-related capabilities retain separate governance, data and responsibilities.
